name: apphandoff
description: AppHandoff for Claude Code: wakes a chat when someone posts on a ticket it claimed or created (it claims the ticket for the chat first, a write on your board, and releases it when the chat ends; a person's message makes the chat ask you what to do through a board question) or decides a milestone approval or answers a question it asked, or when a person accepts or drops a milestone it worked on, and, only if you turn it on with /inbox standby, lets one chat answer for the board by claiming messages nobody answered.
